finding: Persisting one fully expanded JSON trade list per distinct mask class would repeat shared structural executions at very large scale. The frozen GA1 worker already exposes a semantics-preserving carrier factorization: 24 structural groups x 28 transform carriers per group, with three rearm evaluations per transform. Production normalization should execute shared carrier events once and reuse those exact normalized executions when materializing candidate rows.
constraints: Do not change the 303572 class universe, semantic root or alias root.
Do not change event admission, Bid/Ask execution, stop/gap/same-day semantics, overlap policy or management units.
Do not read economic PnL while designing or validating the transport.
